Earlier, Belarus had ended cooperation with the EU to stem illegal migration. This was Lukashenka's answer to the European Union sanctions on the political regime of Belarus (read more about sanctions here). Several investigative journalists (here) and (here) have proven that some migrants arrive in Belarus by commercial flights from Baghdad to Minsk. Information gathered also suggests that migrants are regularly transported by bus to the Belarusian-Lithuanian border. More information about Lukashenka's role in the organisation of the current migration crisis can be found here and here. The European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has stated that the situation on the EU-Belarus border is "the attempt of an authoritarian regime to try to destabilise its democratic neighbours". Similarly, High Representative Borrell has highlighted that the Lukashenka regime is weaponising human beings as a tool for political purposes by giving migrants false expectations and putting them in a situation of extreme vulnerability. On 15 November 2021, the EU broadened the scope for sanctions to tackle hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants. The EU will now be able to target individuals and entities organising or contributing to activities by the Lukashenka regime that facilitate the illegal crossing of the EU's external borders.See related examples of disinformation claims about migration here.

Title: The migration crisis is the fault of the West

See our articles on the Belarus migrants situation here and here.

Title: NATO behaviour with Russia and Belarus is unfriendly

However, NATO-Russia practical cooperation has been suspended since 2014 in response to Russia's aggressive actions against Ukraine. NATO relations with Belarus was based on the pursuit of common interests. The deterioration of these relations was caused by the ongoing development since August 2020. In November 2021, Allies suspended all practical cooperation, both civilian and military, between NATO and Belarus, while maintaining dialogue, as necessary. See other examples of disinformation about NATO: NATO violated its pledge not to move Eastwards; NATO will help Ukraine to kill more people; NATO is an aggressive block that considers Russia as enemy.

Title: Ukraine was created by Lenin, Stalin, and Khrushchev

Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative denigrating the history of Ukraine and its statehood. The history of Ukraine dates back to the era of the Kyivan Rus’ in the 9th-13th centuries. A fully independent Ukraine only emerged in the 20th century, after long periods of successive domination by Poland-Lithuania, Russia, and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR). In the aftermath of World War I and the disintegration of the Russian and Austro-Hungarian Empires two states were created: the Ukrainian People's Republic (UNR) and the West Ukrainian People's Republic. They merged into a unified state - the Ukrainian People's Republic - on 22 January 1919. Under Lenin's leadership at the beginning of the 20th century, Ukraine was occupied by the Bolsheviks and for decades was under communist control. When the Soviet Union began to unravel in 1990–91, the legislature of the Ukrainian SSR declared sovereignty (July 16, 1990) and then outright independence (August 24, 1991). With the dissolution of the USSR in December 1991, Ukraine gained full independence. The EUvsDisinfo database contains other examples of this disinformation narrative, for instance, that Ukraine was created by Vladimir Lenin, that Ukraine was artificially created by the Bolsheviks, that Ukrainian statehood is an inheritance from Soviet Ukraine, or that Ukraine never had independence before joining the Soviet Union.

Title: The OPCW is hiding the chemical formula of the substance used to poison Navalny
Disinformation: The OPCW is hiding the chemical formula of the substance allegedly used to poison Alexei Navalny.The activist's alleged poisoning was in reality a Western provocation designed to discredit, contain, and attack Russia. Information: The story advances a recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative concerning the poisoning of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny. Initially hospitalised in Omsk, at the request of his family, he was transferred to Charité hospital in Berlin, where clinical findings indicated that he was poisoned with a substance from the group of cholinesterase inhibitors. Subsequent toxicological tests provided unequivocal evidence of a chemical nerve agent of the Novichok group in his blood samples. After Germany requested its technical assistance, the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), of which Russia is a member, issued a statement verifying previous statements by the German authorities. The OPCW findings corroborated earlier independent conclusions by German, French, and Swedish laboratories.

Title: Green energy is a new form of colonialism
Disinformation: All the hype in the Western press about "green energy" is a priority of the USA and the EU; it is nothing but a way to prove the ideologically moral right of the West to impose additional duties on the goods they claim is made with "dirty energy" that comes from developing countries, whose industries are developing faster and more successfully against the background of the West's loss of its industry. Information: This is a recurring pro-Kremlin narrative trying to cast doubt on the existence of a climate threat by presenting it as a tool of political and economic manipulation, and often presents it as a way for the West to restrain its alleged competitors. Low-income countries are in fact the most impacted by climate change and the least able to afford its consequences. Climate issues will also constitute a more serious barrier for development and progress in lower-income countries. According to the World Health Organisation, as of the year 2030, climate change is expected to contribute to approximately 250,000 additional deaths per year, from malnutrition, malaria, diarrhea and heat stress, most of which will take place in poor communities. Back in 1992, the first international climate treaty (The Earth Summit) acknowledged that countries had different historic responsibilities for emissions, as well as varying abilities to reduce them going forwards. This is still a principle that drives different country commitments today with higher income countries on average making larger commitments. Surely, much more still needs to be done, not much less like pro-Kremlin narratives usually push for by claiming the whole issue is a hoax. See the full debunk of this disinformation claim here. No international body has recognised the so-called Crimea referendum, announced on 27 February 2014, and held on 16 March 2014. Title: Eastern Partnership aimed at preventing integration of six republics into Eurasian space
Disinformation: In 2009, Brussels launched the Eastern Partnership (EaP) programme for six post-Soviet republics - Ukraine, Belarus, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan as a mechanism for their rapprochement with the EU. Brussels kept all six post-Soviet states in limbo for many years in a row and with an undefined status.
Information: The Eastern Partnership programme is a frequent target of pro-Kremlin disinformation. The Eastern Partnership (EaP) is a joint policy initiative that aims to deepen and strengthen relations between the European Union (EU), its Member States and its six Eastern neighbours: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. Within this framework, guiding the EU's relations with its neighbours is the EU’s Global Strategy and the European Neighbourhood Policy, which calls for the need to focus on increasing the stabilisation and resilience of the EU's Eastern neighbours. It is a mutually beneficial and constructive platform for countries in the region to build a closer relationship with the EU if they choose to do so.The EU does not demand any of its partners to make a choice between the EU or any other country. The Eastern Partnership was not an obstacle for Armenia and Belarus to join the Eurasian Economic Union. On 28 June 2021, the Belarusian regime took a unilateral decision to suspend (not terminate) its participation in the Eastern Partnership; a step that was met with broad criticism.As for the claim that the EU kept all six post-Soviet states with an undefined status, it was initially known that the Eastern Partnership initiative is not an EU accession process.

Title: Lithuania could present territorial claims for the Kaliningrad region

See previous examples of disinformation messages alleging that Kaliningrad exclave is threatened by NATO; The US plans to take over the Kaliningrad region and Aim of NATO’s exercise: prepare for the annexation of Russia’s Kaliningrad region.

Currently, the Polish authorities are in a legal discussion with EU institutions regarding several important issues connected to the independence of the Polish judiciary system, functioning of the Rule of Law mechanisms and primacy of EU law.Read similar cases concerning the relations between the EU and its eastern neighbours: Belarus leaving the EaP disabled EU from completing a cordon sanitaire between the Baltic to the Black Seas; Eastern Partnership is the anti-Russian and “postcolonial” project of the EU; and Eastern Partnership, the tool of Russophobes in the big game against the East, failed in Belarus.

Title: Western Europeans perceive the Poles as “Eastern barbarians” and “Slavic pigs”
Disinformation: The media in the countries of the “Old Europe” promote one message: Poland is a disgrace to the European integration and its behaviour threatens the existence of the European Union. These EU member states are regularly accused of being pro-American “puppets” and a “dead weight” for the EU. The claim that Western Europe does not consider Poland as a fully-fledged part of Europe is ungrounded – Poland is an integral part of the European civilization, an active EU member and one of the most euro-optimistic countries in the Union. The claim that Western Europe perceives the Poles as “barbarians and pigs” is an attempt to humiliate the Poles. The EU enlargement rounds of 2004 and 2007 have been clearly perceived as an impressive success for the European Union and its new member states. Read more about the EU enlargement here.See other disinformation messages connected to Eastern and Central Europe - Eastern European countries in NATO are under Washington’s political and military control, Eastern European countries are under the influence of Western special services and The global deep state turned Eastern Europe in a territory of plunder and devastation.

Title: Poland set to fight migrants with tanks, searches for excuse to close in on Belarus
Disinformation: Poland has decided to combat illegal migrants on the border with Belarus with tanks. Warsaw is just searching for an excuse to move its troops closer to Belarusian borders. Minsk will react very sharply. Belarus and Russia have what to respond with. The reaction will be very sharp, regardless of any criticism from Poland.

It is true that according to news sources 9,500 Polish soldiers weredeployed along the country's border with Belarus and more are added, up to 12.000, as part of increased security measures amid a sharp influx of illegal migrants. But there is hardly any evidence of preparations to employ tanks in the region. Polish Defence Minister Mariusz Błaszczak has said that these soldiers provide support to the Border Guard by protecting the country's border and not allowing it to be illegally crossed. This military build-up along the border is not aimed at attacking Belarus on any other country but at guaranteeing security in the border area. In 2021, Lithuania, Poland and Latvia faced an influx of irregular migrants from Belarus. Earlier, Belarus had ended cooperation with the EU to stem illegal migration. This was Lukashenka's answer to the European Union sanctions on the political regime of Belarus (read more about sanctions here). Lukashenka's regime is using migrants from the Middle East as "political and hybrid" tools against Lithuania and the entire EU. Commissioner Ylva Johansson said, inter alia: "The authoritarian regime in Belarus is exploiting human beings for political reasons: this is completely unacceptable." Investigations have revealed that the Belarusian regime is encouraging people from conflict zones in Africa and the Middle East to come to Minsk. They are driven to border countries such as Lithuania and Poland after that and left there to ask for asylum status.

Title: Negotiations between Gazprom and Moldova are purely commercial and not political
Disinformation: There is no political aspect in the negotiations between Moldova and Gazprom on natural gas. These negotiations are purely commercial as there is an offer by Gazprom, while at the same time the Moldovan authorities have a debt towards the Russian company.
Information: Disinformation about the topic of energy, accompanying a Russian policy of pressure on the Moldovan government. Gazprom is a Russian state company and was the monopolist supplier of natural gas to Moldova until recently. In October 2021, Moldova’s government announced it had bought a million cubic metres of natural gas from Poland after Chisinau failed to agree on a new energy deal with the traditional supplier, calling it "the first purchase of gas from alternative sources” in the history of independent Moldova. The EU mobilised financial support to assist Moldova through the gas crisis and the negotiations for a new gas delivery contract which eventually was concluded with Gazprom on 29 October..As the Financial Times reported, in negotiations in October 2021, Gazprom told Moldovan officials it would reduce the price if the country was prepared to amend its tariff-free trade deal with the EU, said people briefed on the discussions. Gazprom also wanted Moldova to delay the implementation of EU rules that require gas markets to be liberalised and allow more competition, the people said. Gazprom abruptly increased prices for gas for Moldova. Some experts say Moscow has boosted prices as a reprisal against Moldova for electing pro-Western President Maia Sandu last year. See also "The new pro-European government of Moldova introduces censorship on Russian TV channels" and other disinformation cases on Moldova.

Title: The West has declared a biological war on Russia
Disinformation: A hitherto unknown [Coronavirus] strain has appeared in Russia, which has no analogue in the world. There is speculation that the West has taken advantage of the current events and deliberately spread the new virus under the guise of Coronavirus infection and declared a biological war on Russia.
Information: Recurring unfounded pro-Kremlin disinformation about the coronavirus and about biological weapons, alleging the West is pursuing a belligerent and hostile agenda waging biological war on Russia.In late October 2021, Russia reported "isolated cases" of COVID-19 with a subvariant of the Delta variant that is believed to be even more contagious. The same subvariant, designated as AY.4.2, is also growing in the UK. Pro-Kremlin outlets often claim that the West, and especially, the US, develop biological weapons in laboratories around the world and, particularly, across the Russian borders. This claim has been repeatedly debunked by independent fact-checkers and experts. In fact, most of these labs are actively engaged in fighting dangerous diseases and viruses, including COVID-19.

Title: New date for Ukrainian offensive in Donbas
Disinformation: Kyiv found a new date for its offensive against the republics in the Donbas, which will be closer to the winter. Recently, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said at the Yalta European Strategic Forum that an unrestricted war between Russia and Ukraine is "likely."
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative accusing Ukraine of planning war in the Donbas. According to President Zelenskyy, Ukraine is committed to the Minsk agreements. He has also stated that Ukraine has taken significant steps to de-escalate the situation in the East.Moreover, President Zelenskyy never said the all-out war between Russia and Ukraine was "likely" at the Yalta Forum. The claim deliberately twist his words. He actually said, in response to a question, that "It's the worst thing that could happen, but unfortunately there is that possibility."

Title: Western attempts to destroy values, the family and the state are destined to fail
Disinformation: The West's attempts to destroy basic values, such as the family and the state, threaten its existence on the one hand, and are destined to fail on the other.
Information: This is a recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative aimed at portraying the West and Western values as pernicious, immoral, degenerate and a threat to traditional values. The narrative about “threatened values”, one of the most common pro-Kremlin narratives, suggests that those who are committed to traditional values are now threatened by those who oppose them and instead seek to establish a morally bankrupt dystopia. These narratives aim at portraying the West as depraved and endangering societies by imposing the same beliefs on other countries. It undermines progressive Western attitudes about a variety of normative issues, including the rights of women, ethnic and religious minorities, and LGBTQ groups, among others. Read similar cases claiming that Western societies are decadent, worship money and are devoted to the obsessive search for pleasure, that the West seeks to degrade and discredit traditional values, the Vatican lobbies for sodomy, that Belgium is to prosecute the promotion of traditional family values, Europe legalises and declares paedophilia as a norm, Germany and the EU want to legalise paedophilia, or Incest is being legalised in Europe, and The West is lobbying for perversion.

Title: Western curators want Kyiv to start a war in Donbas and involve Moscow in conflict
Disinformation: Kyiv has only one option to abandon the Minsk agreements - to unleash a war in Donbas, dragging Moscow into the conflict. This is needed not so much by the Ukrainian authorities as by their Western curators. The Bayraktar drones, purchased by Ukraine from Turkey, are like the very gun hanging on the wall in the first act of the play, which must be fired at the end. The fact that right now Ukraine has used a Turkish-made drone may indicate that the Donbas tragedy is really coming to a head.
Information: Recurrent pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about Minsk Agreements, accusing Kyiv of escalating the conflict in Eastern Ukraine and challengingUkrainian statehood. Ukraine is a sovereign and independent state with a democratically-elected president and parliament. Both the EU and the US respect Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity.On 26 October, Ukrainian Armed Forces used a Turkish Bayraktar TB2 armed drone to destroy a howitzer used by pro-Russian separatists in Donbas. The drone was used in response to the artillery shelling from the occupied territories in which 3 Ukrainian soldiers were wounded and 1 killed. However, this does not mean that Ukraine is preparing military provocations in Donbas. Kyiv has repeatedly stated that it is not interested in escalation and that it prefers a peaceful solution. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that the Minsk agreements are the only option to end the war in Donbas. See similar cases claiming that Ukraine is preparing a military attack on Donbas, that Ukraine tries to drag Russia into hostilities in Donbas, that Ukraine is the first one to refuse from establishing peace in Donbas.

Title: By awarding Navalny the Sakharov Prize, the West is supporting its lackey
Disinformation: By awarding this year's Sakharov Prize to convicted felon Alexei Navalny, the West has yet again proven that the activist is a foreign agent receiving support from abroad.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative seeking to discredit jailed opposition activist Alexei Navalny.There is no evidence to suggest that the Russian opposition figure Alexei Navalny is a "lackey" acting in the interests of the West. Alexei Navalny has long been the most prominent face of Russian opposition to President Vladimir Putin. Navalny's candidacy in the 2018 presidential election was banned by authorities over his conviction by a Russian court for embezzlement, which bars him from running for office. He has been arrested and imprisoned several times during his political career. Most recently Alexei Navalny was detained and sentenced following his return to Moscow from Germany, where he was treated for the poisoning with Novichok-type nerve agent. The EU has condemned the detention of Alexei Navalny and called for his immediate release. In addition to founding the Russia of the Future party in 2018, Navalny is also the founder and leader of the "Anti-Corruption Foundation" (FBK), which has investigated embezzlement from the Russian state budget, uncovered the lives of Russian politicians and businessmen close to the government and different corruption practices. FBK's goal is to eliminate corruption. Their funding comes from donations and therefore the Ministry of Justice of the Russian Federation recognised FBK as a "foreign agent" due to the Russian "foreign agent" law because they receive donations from outside Russia. However, FBK does not agree with this claim and is appealing it in court.

Title: Energy crisis in the EU was provoked by the US and the EU itself
Disinformation: EU officials make strategic decisions based on false messages, not knowing the real situation. But Putin counted everything for them. The energy deficit in Europe could be about 70 billion cubic metres. This is the result of the economic policy of the European Commission. Russia has nothing to do with it.In fact, Russia does not reduce and, moreover, does not hold back gas supplies to Europe, but increases them.
Information: The statements are untrue. Already in August 2021, Gazprom announced that it expects exports to Europe at 183 billion cubic metres. This is the upper limit of the company's previous forecasts, but significantly less than it supplied at comparable production levels in 2018-2019.Gazprom began to cut supplies to the European Union in the summer of 2021 when the storage season started and left its own UGS facilities in Germany empty by more than half. By 18 October 2021, Gazprom booked about a third of offered additional gas transit capacity via the Yamal-Europe pipeline via Poland for November and has not booked any volumes via Ukraine. Gazprom's data studied by Reuters also showed its gas exports declined in the first half of October from the same period in September.Since October, the company has reduced transit through Ukraine by 20% and three times through Poland via the Yamal-Europe pipeline. Finally, after Putin ordered Gazprom to fill EU stocks, gas prices went down on 29 October.Analysts have told Reuters that Gazprom has not booked larger volumes in a move to push for the Nord Stream 2 gas pipeline, which is awaiting regulatory clearance from Germany to start gas exports. This was confirmed by sources close to Gazprom and the Kremlin, Bloomberg reports. A group of European Parliament lawmakers has asked the European Commission to investigate Gazprom's role in soaring European gas prices, saying the company's behaviour had made them suspect market manipulation. The artificial creation of a deficit in order to increase prices is a classic case of violation of both Russian and European antitrust laws to which Gazprom is committed. See other disinformation related to Europe's energy supply here.

Title: Gazprom's new prices for Moldova have nothing to do with politics
Disinformation: Moldova, another former Soviet republic with European aspirations and dreams of NATO, is at risk of freezing before winter begins.It is clear that Gazprom is not a charity organisation. Gazprom is a joint stock company and cannot operate at a loss, cannot afford to lose tax payments to the RF budget. There are limits to patience. Moldova is provoking a crisis with its own hands.
Information: Disinformation about the topic of energy, accompanying a Russian policy of pressure on the Moldova government.Background: Gazprom is a Russian state company and was the monopolist supplier of natural gas to Moldova until October 2021. On 25 October 2021, Moldova’s government announced it had bought a million cubic meters of natural gas from Poland after Chisinau failed to agree on a new energy deal with traditional supplier Russia, calling it "the first purchase of gas from alternative sources” in the history of independent Moldova. Pro-Kremlin media Tsargrad described the situation as following: "Let us remind you that Moldova has had a preferential gas agreement since 2008. Such conditions were achieved at one time in the negotiations, including thanks to the political component. Or, to be more precise, only thanks to the political component. However, after the pro-European PAS party came to power in Moldova (now in its hands the posts of president, head of government and speaker of parliament), the accents in foreign policy, to put it mildly, shifted". Russian state news agency RIA predicts that the absence of a deal with Gazprom may lead to collapse of the pro-European politicians' ratings: "But he [a politologist] expects the parties to work out mutually beneficial terms. Otherwise, the cold winter will be too hard for Moldovans. And then there is no doubt that the ratings of the new pro-European government will collapse". The "transparent" price of Gazprom's gas varies from one country to another. Thus, the prices for Hungary are two times lower than the proposed prices for Moldova: Hungary signed a 15-year natural gas supply contract with Gazprom. The price at this stage is approximately $350.See also "The new pro-European government of Moldova introduces censorship on Russian TV channels" and other disinformation cases on Moldova. See"Green energy is a scam, Gazprom is a safer" , The EU gas problems are a result of its fight for “energy independence” and other disinformation cases on Gazprom.

Title: In the West, pandemic and climate change are used to impose a new control regime
Disinformation: In the West, the social system exploited the pandemic and climate change to impose a new control regime. Information: Recurrent pro-Kremlin disinformation claiming that the global secret elites are exploiting the coronavirus pandemic and climate agenda to establish new forms of authoritarian or totalitarian control over the masses.Western government’s anti-COVID measures are not aimed at surveilling and censoring and do not pursue the establishment of authoritarian social control. Emergency provisions - such as the temporary limitations of freedom of movement and social distancing, Covid health certificates - are tools that democratic governments need to use, for a limited period of time, in order to effectively protect the public health of citizens.This message is also consistent with the pro-Kremlin narrative claiming that the West is allegedly exploiting the environmental agenda and the climate change issue for self-serving reasons. Climate change has been another target of disinformation for several years.Read similar cases claiming that COVID-19 pandemic serves the agenda of authoritarian control over democratic countries, that New model of colour revolutions based on an environmentalist agenda could be created or that Western campaign against COVID-19 aims to impose control over society

Title: No evidence for Russian involvement in MH17
Disinformation: The Dutch investigation into the MH17 case - which only included western investigators - knew immediately that pro-Russian separatists shot the plane down, but showed no evidence for this to this day. The plane was shot down by Western intelligence services with the help of Ukraine, but if they admitted it, it would be proven that it is in fact them who are war criminals.
Information: Recurrent pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative on the downing of flight MH17 over Ukraine, aiming to discredit the criminal trial and the Joint Investigation Team (JIT). The reason for Russia's non-involvement in the investigation is that the crash did not take place over Russian territory and claimed no Russian lives. Dutch Chief Prosecutor Fred Westerbeke told a Russian newspaper that "if MH17 were shot down over Russia, I would have suggested that Russia be made a member of the JIT group." The Joint Investigation Team (JIT) has concluded that flight MH17 was shot down on 17 July 2014 by a missile of the 9M38 series, launched by a BUK-TELAR, from farmland in the vicinity of Pervomaiskiy. At that time, the area was controlled by Russia-backed armed formations. The BUK-TELAR was brought in from the territory of the Russian Federation and subsequently, after having shot down flight MH17, was taken back to the Russian Federation. On 24 May 2018, JIT stated that the BUK-TELAR that was used to down MH17 originates from the 53rd Anti Aircraft Missile brigade, a unit of the Russian army from Kursk in the Russian Federation. The JIT reached this conclusion after extensive comparative research.For similar cases, see here and here. For our overview and analysis of disinformation narratives around the downing of MH17, click here.

Title: The US forbids Georgia to engage in direct dialogue with Russia
Disinformation: The West, and particularly the US, is strongly opposing Georgia acting in its own interests and engaging in direct dialogue with Russia in order to return the lost territories and develop the economy. The “strategic partner” is prohibiting Georgia from having a dialogue with Russia.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative undermining the Georgian statehood, as if like puppets Georgia is ruled by the West.Contrary to the claim, the US does not prohibit Georgia from engaging in a dialogue with Russia. Georgia broke off diplomatic relations with Russia because the latter attacked Georgia in 2008. Russia continues its military presence in both Abkhazia and South Ossetia in violation of international law and commitments undertaken by Russia under the 12 August 2008 agreement, mediated by the European Union. Many international organisations condemn the further occupation of Abkhazia and South Ossetia, see e.g. the CSCE statement here and the European Parliament's declaration. Currently, Georgia engages with Russia at the Geneva International Discussions (GID) – the multilateral forum to address security and humanitarian consequences of the Russo-Georgian War of August 2008, attended by Georgia’s Western partners as well. Moreover, Special Representative of the Georgian Prime Minister for Relations with Russia Zurab Abashidze and Russian former Deputy Foreign Minister Grigory Karasin hold regular meetings, often referred to as Abashidze-Karasin format.

Title: Chisinau wants to redistribute energy flows in the region and block Transnistria
Disinformation: Chisinau implements a programme of the West to redistribute energy flows in the region. The goal is to block Transnistria with the subsequent expulsion of the Russian military from the region.
Information: Recurring disinformation narrative on Gazprom and the gas crisis in Moldova in October 2021. Gazprom abruptly increased prices for gas for Moldova. Some experts say Moscow has boosted prices as a reprisal against Moldova for electing pro-Western President Maia Sandu last year. While the negotiations between Gazprom and Moldovan representatives were ongoing in October 2021, Moldova's authorities also managed to find alternative sources of gas as a temporary solution. Thus, the European Union announced that it will provide the Republic of Moldova with a non-reimbursable aid of 60 million euros to overcome the gas crisis.There is no evidence to support the claim that the gas crisis had as its goal blocking Transnistria or that Chisinau implements a Western programme of energy redistribution. On top of that, Transnistria is dependent on Gazprom's contract with Moldova, which stipulates volumes to be delivered to right-bank Moldova and Transnistria separately.There is no sinister motive. The new contract agreed on 29 October 2021 between Gazprom and Moldovagaz does not exclude Transnistria or hurt it in any other way.

Title: US and Russia agreed on Donbas' autonomy
Disinformation: Back in the Geneva Summit, Putin and Biden made a deal on reintegrating Donbas into Ukraine and granting special status and autonomy to the region.
Information: Recurring disinformation narrative spread by pro-Kremlin media outlets aimed at emphasising "peace on Russian terms" in the Donbas War and denigrading Ukraine as a soverign state.Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Joe Biden met in Geneva in June 2021. While Ukraine was part of the discussion during the meeting, the summit between the two heads of state ended with no political decisions about Ukraine.The Geneva Summit was heavily covered by pro-Kremlin media. See a similar disinformation case here accusing Joe Biden of being afraid of holding a joint press conference with his Russian counterpart.

Title: Germany's Greens no longer oppose Nord Stream 2
Disinformation: Germany's Alliance 90/The Greens party, hitherto firmly opposed to the launch of Nord Stream 2, has recently softened its stance on the Russian-German pipeline.This metamorphosis occurred shortly after the party began negotiations with its potential coalition partners in the Bundestag. While previously demanding that the energy project be shut down, party co-chair Annalena Baerbock now merely argues that the project should comply with EU legislation, which is an easily surmountable technicality.According to the Die Welt newspaper, the Social Democratic party has asked Baerbock to maintain calm and professionalism - the qualities she must possess if she wants to pursue the post of foreign minister.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation campaign regarding the Nord Stream 2 pipeline.There is no indication that the Greens' stance on the Nord Stream 2 project has softened. In a 20 October 2021 article published in Die Welt, Baerbock is cited as saying the EU should hold off on the approval of the pipeline. A Politico article from the same day quotes Baerbock as saying that "'[w]e can't allow ourselves to be blackmailed' by Russia"; and arguing Moscow is partly to blame for the recent energy price surge across Europe: "This is a situation 'intentionally brought about' in order to 'force the rapid commissioning of Nord Stream 2,' Baerbock concluded." See here for the full debunk by The Insider (in Russian).

Title: Return of Crimean artefacts from the Netherlands to Ukraine is legitimised robbery
Disinformation: A Dutch appeals court’s ruling about the return of Crimean gold artefacts from the Netherlands to Ukraine is a politicised decision and can be regarded as a legitimised robbery of cultural values.
Information: Disinformation claim that appeared in the context of illegal annexation of Crimea.A Dutch museum borrowed a trove of ancient Scythian treasures in February 2014 from four museums in Crimea and one museum from Kyiv for an exhibition named "Crimea - Gold and secrets of the Black Sea". It was shortly before the illegal annexation of the peninsula by Russia. The legal action began in 2014 when the Crimean museums tried to have the gold collection back to the occupied peninsula. A Dutch court ruled on 14 December 2016 in favour of Ukraine. An appeals court backed the previous ruling on 26 October 2021. This ruling is not a robbery, it is a rightful decision to return the gold treasures to the country where they belong. The European Union does not recognise Russia’s claim for sovereignty over Crimea. It means that the artefacts must return to their country of origin, that is Ukraine. Ukrainian Justice Minister Denys Malyuska said that the Crimean museums may file a complaint against the court's ruling, but their chances of success are very small. The Scythians were a group of ancient nomadic warrior tribes known from the 9th century BC to the 2nd century BC. Part of them lived on the territory of contemporary Southern Ukraine, particularly Crimea. Although they did not have a system of writing and were illiterate, they were known for their mastery in making exquisite gold jewellery. Read similar disinformation narratives about the West’s alleged anti-Russian activities.

Title: Ukraine is trying to illegally change the geographical and political status of Crimea
Disinformation: The decision of the Dutch appeals court to return the collection of ancient Gold artefacts from museums of Crimea to Ukraine means stealing cultural heritage from the people of Crimea. The representatives of Ukraine, in the case of Gold artefacts, are trying to change the geographical and political status of Crimea. It is an illegal action.
Information: The claim is linked to the illegal annexation of Crimea. The case in question is about a legal dispute revolving around a collection of ancient Crimean gold artefacts. The collection was borrowed by the Allard Pierson Museum in Amsterdam for the exhibition “Crimea - Gold and secrets of the Black Sea” in February 2014, shortly before the annexation of the peninsula by Moscow.After the annexation of Crimea, Russia claimed the collection back. The position of Kyiv was that the collection should return to Ukraine. On 26 October 2021, the Dutch appeals court finally decided in favour of Ukraine. The decision of the court was based on a 1995 Ukrainian Museum Act, which meant that the whole collection was part of Ukraine's cultural heritage. Crimea is an internationally recognised part of Ukraine. The so-called referendum was organised hastily and at gunpoint following the covert invasion of “little green men” and barring impartial observers from entering the peninsula. The EU (as well as the UN) does not recognise and continues to strongly condemn this violation of international law, and has imposed restrictive measures against the Russian Federation in response to the crisis in Ukraine. See similar cases of disinformation alleging that Crimea rejoined Russia as a result of a popular referendum, or that the fate and future of Crimea are forever with Russia or that Russia has never violated the provisions of the Budapest Memorandum.

Title: The EU is experiencing a gas crisis because of the United States
Disinformation: It's time for the EU to admit: it is experiencing a gas supply crisis because of the United States.
Information: Pro-Kremlin disinformation related to the Russian gas policy in Europe. This narrative promotes a traditional pro-Kremlin message that Russia is the only reliable partner for Europe.In August-September 2021, the European market faced an unprecedented spike in gas prices. One of the reasons for this situation is, according to the experts, a visible reduction in Russian gas supplies to Europe. For example, the gas supply via the Yamal-Europe pipeline was reduced by more than 50%. In this situation, experts accuse Russia of weaponising gas supplies in order to exert pressure on the EU. Graphs here show how Russia's gas exports to Europe have changed in 2019-2021. In September 2021, a group of European Parliament members appealed for an investigation into the role of Gazprom in the massive increase in gas prices in Europe. This situation is perceived as Russian pressure on the EU to accelerate the launch of the Nord Stream 2 pipeline. US energy secretary Jennifer Granholm said the rise in prices had “raised serious concerns and questions on the reliability of the existing supply and security in Europe”. There are no reasons to believe that the United States was to blame for the situation with gas. See more cases concerning energy in Europe: Europe catastrophically lacks gas; the US wants to completely capture the European gas market; the US would like to resell Russian gas to Europe; Russia uses gas not for blackmail but for mutually beneficial cooperation.

Title: Ukraine is ruled by a Nazi junta
Disinformation: Russia must force the Nazi junta ruling Ukraine to stop the Donbas war.
Information: This is a recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative painting the post-2014 Ukrainian leadership as a Nazi/Fascist "junta," which allegedly came to power following a violent coup d'etat. Ukraine is not governed by a junta. Democratic, competitive and generally well-organised presidential and parliamentary elections were held in 2014 and local elections in 2015. The EU welcomed this progress. The OSCE, which observed all these elections on the ground, characterised the presidential elections as showing the "clear resolve of the authorities to hold what was a genuine election largely in line with international commitments and with a respect for fundamental freedoms." The 2019 early parliamentary elections, according to the preliminary statement of the OSCE, were efficiently run and respected fundamental freedoms. The European Parliament election observation delegation to Ukraine said in a statement that notwithstanding the fact that the elections were taking place a few months earlier than planned, one can undoubtedly say that they were competitive, well-administered and managed in an efficient way.The demonstrations which began in Kyiv in November 2013 – called "Maidan", or "Euromaidan" – were a result of the Ukrainian people's frustration with former President Yanukovych's last-minute U-turn when, after seven years of negotiation, he refused to sign the EU–Ukraine Association Agreement and halted progress towards Ukraine's closer relationship with the EU due to Russian pressure. The protesters' demands included constitutional reform, a stronger role for parliament, formation of a government of national unity, an end to corruption, early presidential elections and an end to violence. For similar cases, see here.

Title: Russian talks with Ukraine are pointless since Zelensky is not the one in charge
Disinformation: For us [Russians], there is no point in dealing with vassal states. We need to negotiate with the overlord [the US].
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative aimed at portraying Ukraine as a non-independent state that is under direct foreign control.Since 16 July 1990, when it adopted the Declaration of State Sovereignty, Ukraine is an independent and sovereign state. It has democratically elected state institutions, including Parliament and a President, who take all the decisions regarding state governance.As a sovereign states it decides freely its own international political orientation.The US has a strategic partnership with Ukraine. The US secretary Antony J. Blinken, who visited Ukraine on May 6, 2021, stated that “The United States stands firmly behind the sovereignty and the territorial integrity of Ukraine”. See similar cases of pro-Kremlin disinformation here.

Title: Migrant woman miscarries after being beaten up by Polish law enforcer
Disinformation: A pregnant refugee has miscarried after a Polish serviceman kicked her in the belly several times on the Belarusian border. Her son said he saw an elderly Polish law enforcer with one star on his epaulettes do it. The woman later started bleeding and miscarried.
Information: Unsubstantiated claim based on unverified evidence from an unidentified migrant, quoted by a Telegram channel run by Belarusian border authorities and by several pro-Kremlin outlets.In 2021, Lithuania, Poland and Latvia faced an influx of irregular migrants arriving via Belarus. Earlier, Belarus had terminated cooperation with the EU to stem illegal migration. This was Lukashenka's answer to the European Union's sanctions on the political regime of Belarus (read more about sanctions here).There is plenty of evidence that the Belarusian authorities have instigated the ongoing migration crisis in Lithuania, Poland and Latvia. Lukashenka's regime is using migrants from the Middle East as "political and hybrid" tools against Lithuania and the entire EU. Commissioner for Home Affairs Ylva Johansson has said that "[t]he authoritarian regime in Belarus is exploiting human beings for political reasons" and called the behaviour of the regime "completely unacceptable".Several investigative journalists and have proven (see here and here) that some migrants arrive in Belarus by commercial flights from Baghdad to Minsk. Information gathered also suggests that migrants are regularly transported by bus to the Belarusian-Lithuanian border. More information about Lukashenka's role in the organisation of the current migration crisis can be found here and here.Read more disinformation reports about the Belarus border crisis.

Title: Anti-vaccine ideology came to Russia from the West
Disinformation: Anti-vaccine ideology in Russia is being spread by the West.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative surrounding the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic and the related issue of vaccination.Available data shows that the Russians' skepticism toward vaccination against Covid-19 is homegrown. According to the Levada Centre, Russia's top independent pollster, vaccine hesitancy within the country is largely linked to the public's mistrust of the government and its handling of the pandemic.There is abundant evidence, however, that pro-Kremlin disinformation has sought to amplify anti-vaccination messages in the West, question the efficacy of Western vaccines, and blame Western institutions for the low public interest so far in the Russia-made Sputnik V vaccine, both at home and abroad. See here for our six-part reports on this issue.

Title: The West does not shy away from grossly interfering in Georgia’s internal affairs
Disinformation: The West does not shy away from openly ousting the Georgian government and grossly interfering in the country's internal affairs. The West has begun a process of returning the United National Movement (UNM) back into power in Georgia, despite the fact that it knows the vast majority of the Georgian population is categorically against handing over the ruling of the country to criminals.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about the Western interference in Georgia’s internal affairs, challenging Georgian statehood, claiming that Georgia is ruled by the West. Pro-Kremlin outlets often claim that many countries, not under Moscow's control, are "Western puppets". Georgia is a sovereign and independent country that regained its independence in 1991 after the collapse of the USSR. Georgia, as an independent country, has a functioning government and economy, it is a member of many international organisations, such as the United Nations and the Council of Europe, and a party to international agreements. Georgia has bilateral diplomatic relations with the majority of countries and enjoys close partnership relations with the Western countries. The country is not under the control of any foreign government or organisation. Both the EU and the US respect Georgia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Media Development Foundation's media monitoring results revealed that the narrative that the West is meddling in the sovereign affairs of Georgia and virtually running the country is one of the main trends of anti-Western propaganda and disinformation in the country. See related examples of disinformation claims here.

Title: Poland, Lithuania and Ukraine attempted to stage a coup in Belarus
Disinformation: Belarusian politicians and activists, who fled abroad following the coup attempt in Belarus, are toxic for the neighbouring countries. The three main countries where Belarusian activists fled - Poland, Lithuania and Ukraine - contributed to the coup's organisation in Belarus and continue attempts to destabilise the country.Poland wished to bring Belarus into the anti-Russian project Intermarium, to benefit from the destruction of the Belarusian economy, and to get demographic benefits. However, Poland, as well as Lithuania and Ukraine, are losing more than they are getting.
Information: This article contains recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narratives about Western attempts to organise a colour revolution in Belarus and Poland's imperial and hostile plans towards Belarus. There is no basis for the claims that Poland, Lithuania and Ukraine tried to organise a coup in Belarus or that they are trying to destabilise the country. They respect the principles of international law and do not intervene in the domestic affairs of any country.Widespread protests have started in Belarus in August 2020. These were triggered by discontent with the results of the Belarusian presidential elections in August 2020 which were not monitored by independent experts, were neither free nor fair and rigged a victory for Lukashenka who then claimed to be re-elected as president for the sixth consecutive time since 1994.The EU member states perceive the situation in Belarus in a unanimous way, appealing to the Belarusian authorities to stop violence, release political prisoners and organise democratic elections in Belarus. As for the Intermarium project mentioned in the publication, the Three Seas Initiative, also known as the Baltic, Adriatic, Black Sea (BABS) Initiative, is a forum of twelve states in the European Union, located in Central and Eastern Europe. The initiative aims to create a regional dialogue on a variety of questions affecting the member states, primarily transport, energy, and digital. Read more about the present-day view on the Intermarium geopolitical concept here and here. See other examples of similar messages: Poland and Lithuania directly sponsor extremist actions against Belarus, Poland and Lithuania send Belarusian opposition instructions on how to make explosives and CIA, and Pentagon prepares Belarusian protestors in Poland, Ukraine and the Baltic states.

Title: Alleged torture videos in Russian prisons were not given by a whistleblower but sold for US dollars
Disinformation: According to security officials, Sergey Saveliev did not transfer the video files to human rights activists, but sold them for $ 2,000. The funds were transferred to Yandex-wallet.
Information: Classical attempt to discredit a whistleblower who has recently sought asylum in France who reveals embarrassing facts for the Russian authorities and the NGO which defends human rights in prisons. Sergey Savelyev smuggled footage out of Russia showing hundreds of cases of sexual assault and torture of convicts in Russian prisons. Mr. Savelyev started sharing the videos with human rights activists after his release in February 2021. Gulagu.net has said guards and other prison officials bribed or forced inmates to torture other inmates in order to secure false testimonies. The videos purportedly show rape and other forms of torture in Russian prisons and pretrial detention centres in several regions. The NGO Gulagu.net never hid the fact that it helped whistleblower Sergey Saveliev to hide from Russian penitentiary administration and seek asylum in France. However, the video files that were also transmitted to journalists, the UN Human Rights Committee, Council of Europe anti-torture Committee and Interpol were not subject to any transaction and the money transfer system Yandex was not used. The head of Gulagu.net and Sergey Saveliev recounted the story on Russian TV channel Dozhd. Russia, alongside Turkey, ranks amongst the countries with the highest proportion of incarcerated people in Europe, according to a recent report by the Council of Europe. Human rights groups have repeatedly slammed Russia’s "systematic” torture of its prison inmates. Read also: Handcuff marks are not signs of torture of Pratasevich, a fighter of the brutal neo-Nazi battalion, The Council of Europe's Committee for the Prevention of torture visited Chechnya and found no evidence of extrajudicial executions.

Title: Europeans are on the verge of the most absolute misery due to a logistics perfect storm
Disinformation: Europeans are on the verge of the most absolute misery due to the double crisis of containers and energy, both at a global level. A perfect storm that will punish mostly European citizens that see how their oligarchies, who control the energetic companies, enrich themselves more and more at the price of the misery and suffering of their citizens. This is not happening because of the madness of European politicians, but due to very specific oligarchic interest groups. Behind this are the same investment funds, the same groups of economic oligarchs that expect to enrich themselves as always on a crisis that implies the poverty of the people.
Information: This is a mix of several recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narratives about an imminent collapse of Europe and about shadow forces that control the world. There is no evidence to back the claim that this situation is the result of deliberate actions by organised groups.While it is true that the logistics and energetic crises will cause disruptions and harmful situations for many people, there is no reason to think that Europe will be the most affected region, or that will lead to “misery”. In fact, there are elements indicating, unfortunately, that the most vulnerable countries in places like Africa will be hit the hardest. By mixing the energetic and the logistic crises and blaming them on vague “oligarchic interest groups”, this disinformation narrative also serves to deflect all criticism for any alleged Russian responsibility on the energy crisis, after Moscow ignored calls by the International Energy Agency to send more gas to Europe to help with the lowering of prices. Although Russian authorities have denied using energy as a political weapon, and the gas supply problems are the result of multiple factors, many observers believe that Russia is trying to exploit its energy leverage on Europe for political gains. Russian actions in this regard have been surrounded by a centralised disinformation campaign, of which this article is part. See other examples of similar disinformation narratives in our database, such as claims that green energy is a scam and Gazprom is safer, that attempts to find alternatives to Russian gas result in increased energy prices, that the EU gas problems are a result of its fight for “energy independence”, that the Polish position on Nord Stream 2 is energy totalitarianism, or that Russia has never used its energy supplies as a weapon.

Title: The West is the sole responsible for growing tensions between China and Taiwan
Disinformation: What are the reasons behind the rise in tensions between China and Taiwan? Xi Jinping announced this month that Beijing will never renounce the reunification, but this has been the position of the Central Committee of China’s Communist Party, so there is nothing new there. The novelties lie in the joint military exercises carried out by troops of the US, the UK and their allies in the Philippines Sea days before. So to understand this escalation we shouldn’t focus in the tense relations between Beijing and Taipei, which hadn’t changed in 70 years, but to put the spotlight instead in the role of the other actors that are intervening in this situation, considering that China’s global rise is what keeps the White House awake at night.
Information: By claiming that there is nothing new in Beijing’s stance towards Taiwan, this disinformation story ignores China’s latest moves towards the island, such as the record number of Chinese military aircraft that entered Taiwan’s Air Defence Identification Zone in early October. This led Taiwanese minister of defence Chiu Kuo-cheng to affirm that the tensions between China and Taiwan are at its worst point in 40 years, and to claim that the Chinese PeoplesLiberation Army may be fully capable to invade the island by 2025.Besides, Beijing’s ‘wolf warrior diplomacy’, its boycott against Australian goods or its recent moves in Hong Kong -such as the imposition of a draconian National Security Law, the crushing of the autonomy of the city and the massive repression against the democratic movement-, is leading observers to fear that China is adopting a more aggressive stance in the pursuit of its political goals in the international field. Certainly, some recent events such as naval exercises in the Philippines Sea are intended to send a message to China, and other Western moves like the AUKUS alliance are perceived by Beijing as provocative, contributing to the tensions. But the goal of this disinformation story is to put all the blame on China’s adversaries while deliberately blurring the full picture, in order to promote the longstanding pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about an ever-aggressive imperialist West. See other examples in our database, such as claims that the West is applying an “Anaconda ring” of conflicts against China as previously did against Russia, that Hong Kong protests are the West’s revenge on China for not waging war against Russia, that sanctions against China are proof that Western values are nothing but liberal totalitarianism, or that the US seeded chaos in Afghanistan to undermine China and Russia.

Title: NATO will help Ukraine to kill more people
Disinformation: NATO will help Ukraine to kill more people. The Pentagon is happy that Ukraine on the “Russian - American front” becomes the battleground, and Ukrainian people become cannon fodder. NATO is back to the logic of the XX century. It is drawing virtual lines of the battleground between different countries by its own anti-Russian actions.
Information: This is a recurring disinformation narrative about aggressive NATO, claiming that the Alliance is preparing a war with Russia and using Ukraine for its belligerent plans. Neither NATO nor Ukraine are preparing military provocations against Russia. Kyiv has repeatedly stated that it is not interested in escalation and that it prefers a peaceful solution to the Donbas conflict. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that the Minsk agreements are the only option to end the war. NATO supports the territorial integrity of Ukraine and condemns and will not recognise Russia’s illegal and illegitimate annexation of Crimea, and its destabilising and aggressive activities in eastern Ukraine and the Black Sea region. At the same time, NATO has an interest to keep relations with Russia and develop cooperation in areas of common interests. See similar narratives about NATO: NATO preparing military operations against Russia to defend Ukraine; NATO will turn the Baltic States into the epicentre of the nuclear explosion; NATO is creating military bases in Ukraine under the guise of training centres.

Title: Ukrainian commandos seized an observer
Disinformation: Ukrainian commandos have seized an observer from the Joint Centre for Control and Coordination.
Information: This is a disinforming claim misrepresenting a recent incident when Ukrainian troops seized a separatist from the so-called “Luhansk People’s Republic (LNR)”, who was spying on Ukrainian positions, rather than an unarmed observer.Andriy Kosyak was disguised as an official from the Joint Centre for Control and Coordination (JCCC). He is a Ukrainian citizen but received a Russian passport in 2020.The Ukrainian delegation to the Trilateral Contact Group said on its official Facebook page that Kosyak also had “LNR” military documents and firearms. On the morning of 13 October 2021, a group of LNR separatists came out to only demine an area along the line of contact in order to open a new checkpoint there later. The Ukrainian side had given them safety guarantees. However, they were noticed spying on Ukrainian positions instead. The Ukrainians seized one of them. The separatist said during interrogation that he was serving for the “LNR” and that he was carrying firearms, which was a violation of internal rules. Ukrainian law enforcers later discovered that he was also suspected of committing premeditated murder in 2010. The JCCC was set up in 2014 to address current issues in the Minsk format like requests for ceasefires, repairs or demining operations. The OSCE mission to Ukraine said in a report that participants in peace talks had been notified of the accident. It called on the parties to avoid escalation so that such events do not occur in the future. Read more disinformation reports claiming that Ukraine violates the peace process.

Title: The West follows the path of destruction; Russia can become a new ark of civilization
Disinformation: In the course of the technological and digital transformation of the world, the importance of a solid foundation, a value foundation, is increasing. And if in the West this foundation is being eroded by LGBT, transgender and other agendas, then Russia has its own way. The path that the West has embarked on is the path of destruction. Russia, on the other hand, is ready to become a new ark of human civilization, but only for those who accept Russian traditions, foundations, morals and rules.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative portraying the West as a decadent, depraved and immoral actor fighting against traditional values and endangering societies.This narrative portrays the Russian civilisation as morally superior to the Western. "Threatened values" is one of the most common narratives used by pro-Kremlin outlets. The narrative is adapted to a wide range of topics and is typically used to discredit liberal Western attitudes regarding the rights of women, ethnic and religious minorities and LGBTIQ groups among others. Pro-Kremlin outlets often spread the narrative about the deliberate destruction by the West of values such as the traditional family, religion, spirituality and classical culture, eliminating all forms of collective identity. Russia uses this narrative to proclaim itself the defender of traditional social and spiritual values all over the world. See earlier cases alleging that in contrast to Russia, western Europe is abandoning Christian roots and that, unlike Russia, the West is not about fairness or solidarity and it degrades traditional values and endangers societies, while all-Russian history is highly moral.

Title: NATO is an aggressive bloc that considers Russia an enemy
Disinformation: NATO considers Russia to be its adversary, so there is nothing wrong with giving up relations with the organisation. No peace-loving statements, no camouflages of this aggressive orientation of NATO, they are not able to hide the true purpose of this Alliance. This is an aggressive bloc that considers Russia an enemy. And therefore, nothing terrible will happen if Russia, against the background of aggravation of aggressiveness, against the background of declarations that the main task is to contain Russia, we simply abandon these relations.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about NATO, portraying it as an aggressive anti-Russian organisation. NATO is a defensive alliance, whose primary aims are to maintain peace and safeguard the independence, security and territorial integrity of its members. Moreover, NATO poses no threat to Russia. During the Warsaw summit in July 2016, NATO has made it clear that "The Alliance does not seek confrontation and poses no threat to Russia". This was also reaffirmed in the Brussels Summit Communiqué of 14 June 2021.For more than two decades NATO has worked to build a partnership with Russia, including through the NATO-Russia Council (NRC). While NATO stands by its international commitments, Russia continues to breach the values, principles, trust, and commitments outlined in agreed documents that underpin the NATO-Russia relationship. NATO-Russian cooperation has been suspended since 2014 in response to Russia’s military intervention in Ukraine. In response to Russia's aggressive actions, NATO suspended practical cooperation with Russia.. The NATO Summit Communiqué issued in Brussels in June 2021, clearly stated: "Until Russia demonstrates compliance with international law and its international obligations and responsibilities, there can be no return to “business as usual”. We will continue to respond to the deteriorating security environment by enhancing our deterrence and defence posture, including by a forward presence in the eastern part of the Alliance." In October 2021, NATO withdrew the accreditation of eight members of the Russian Mission to NATO, who were undeclared Russian intelligence officers. This decision was based on intelligence. Russia responded by suspending its diplomatic mission to NATO. For more information about NATO-Russia relations and disinformation narratives about NATO, see here and here.

Title: Western press unfairly denigrates Taliban
Disinformation: Squeezing out the Americans and coalition troops is only half the battle for the Taliban. The main war is ahead - the information war. Western press attacks Talibs by claiming that they hang, kill, and chop off people's hands. The people say the opposite, but who in the world hears it? It's all a lie. West only speaks, but there is no confirmation.
Information: Since taking power on 15 August 2021, the Taliban have sought to portray themselves as more tolerant than their global reputation suggests, but incidents of brutality and repression are still being reported in parts of Afghanistan.Taliban fighters massacred nine ethnic Hazara men after taking control of the Ghazni Province in southeastern Afghanistan, Amnesty International (AI) reported. On-the-ground researchers spoke to eyewitnesses who gave harrowing accounts of the killings, which took place between 4-6 July in the village of Mundarakht in the Malistan District. At that, the Taliban have cut mobile phone service in many of the areas they have recently captured, controlling which photographs and videos are then shared from these regions, says AI.Afghan families flee to Pakistan over forced marriage fears. Meanwhile, the Taliban has excluded girls from Afghan secondary schools, with only boys and male teachers allowed back into classrooms. The Taliban said it is working on a plan to allow girls to return to schools, but has not said when that could happen or what conditions may be imposed.More than 220 female Afghan judges are in hiding due to fear of retribution under Taliban rule. Six former female judges spoke to the BBC from secret locations across Afghanistan.Players from the Afghanistan women's volleyball team are hiding from the Taliban and one of the squad was killed for not following Sharia law, BBC reported in September 2021. Taliban denies the killing of Mahjabin Hakimi, an Afghan female volleyball player, but it destroyed the papers of the ongoing investigation.A group of Afghan women urged the United Nations to block the Taliban from gaining a seat at the international body, calling for better representation for their country during a visit to the organisation's New York headquarters. "It's very simple," former Afghan politician and peace negotiator Fawzia Koofi told reporters. "The UN needs to give that seat to somebody who respects the rights of everyone in Afghanistan."See more disinformation cases targeting the situation in Afghanistan.

Title: Ukraine should not join NATO because Ukrainians and Russians are one nation
Disinformation: Membership of Ukraine in NATO is the red line for Russia. Russia should not allow Ukraine to become a member of the Alliance because Ukrainians and Russians are one nation. Membership of Ukraine in NATO will create conditions for civil war. The US is especially interested in it.
Information: A recurring pro-Kremlin narrative about the all-Russian nation and the Russian world/civilisation. In this case, the narrative is used in the context of Ukraine's possible NATO membership. Ukraine is a well-defined nation-state with a long history and its own literature and identity, despite foreign rule for long periods of time. Ukrainians and Russians belong to the Slavs ethnolinguistic group but they are not a single nation. Membership in NATO will not create conditions for war between Ukraine and Russia. NATO is a defensive alliance and its purpose is to guarantee the freedom and security of its members through political and military means. Ukraine is a sovereign state, free to decide its political orientation incl. oninternational organisations and military alliances. Its relationship with NATO dates back to 1991.Pro-Kremlin outlets often recur to the claims that Ukrainians and Russians (as well as Belarusians) are one nation. See similar cases here, here and here.

Title: No evidence of Russian involvement in Skripal poisoning but suspicions of UK's involvement
Disinformation: Russia was accused without any evidence by the UK of being responsible for the attack on the Skripals. Russia has repeatedly denied its involvement. Moreover, the UK is strongly suspected of having developed the chemical A-234 named "Novichok" at Porton Down Military Chemical Laboratory, located near Salisbury and Amesbury.
Information: Recurrent pro-Kremlin disinformation messages about the poisoning and attempted murder of former Russian GRU officer Sergei Skripal. On 4 March 2018, Sergei Skripal and his 33-year-old daughter, Yulia, were found unconscious on a park bench in Salisbury after being poisoned by a nerve agent. At least 21 people received medical treatment due to the attack. The UK investigation found that Sergey and Yuliya Skripal were poisoned using a specific Novichok nerve agent that could only have been produced by non-state actors. This was confirmed by an independent OPCW analysis.The British Police have presented a solid chain of evidence on the Skripal case, with pictures, connecting the suspects to the locations in the case. Parts of the material have been released to the public. The evidence was sufficient to charge two Russian nationals, Anatoliy Chepiga and Aleksandr Mishkin with the attack on the Skripals, both of them Russian military intelligence (GRU) who travelled to the UK using fake names and documents. In September 2021, British police charged in absentia a third Russian GRU agent, Denis Sergeev, who used the alias Sergei Fedotov. See here the EU statement on the Salisbury attack. Read also: The alleged involvement of a third Russian in the Skripal case is another lie, Skripal case is crumbling due to the lack of evidence, Western strategists make baseless accusations about Russia to undermine its political stability

Title: Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew is meeting his masters
Disinformation: Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew is visiting Washington and he will meet US President Joe Biden in the White House. This is not a surprise as the Americans were behind Bartholomew's decision to grant autocephaly to the schismatic Church of Ukraine in order to split Ukraine from Russia.
Information: Pro-Kremlin disinformation outlets frequently attack the establishment of an autocephalous Ukrainian church.The Constantinople Patriarchy, not the US, decided to grant the autocephaly to the Ukrainian church. The final decision was made in January 2019, when all members of the Synod of the Ecumenical Patriarchate signed off the Tomos of autocephaly. The signing of the Tomos happened after years of deliberations as well as careful preparations and considerations by the Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew and the Holy Synod. For more information and analysis on pro-Kremlin disinformation against the Church of Ukraine see here.

Title: The West tries to destroy the economy of Belarus, seizes any opportunity to pressure Belarusians
Disinformation: European and American politicians do not consider it possible to abandon sanctions while striving to destroy the economy of Belarus.The 4th package and sectoral sanctions introduced in June by the EU and the 5th list of restrictions being prepared in Brussels today confirm the thesis that the sanctions are no longer about protecting the rights and freedoms of Belarusians. The West seizes any opportunity in order to annoy Belarusian authorities.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about the belligerent West, particularly the EU, trying to destabilise and destroy Belarus. The EU did not recognise the falsified results of the Belarusian Presidential election on 9 August 2020, nor the new mandate claimed by Alyaksandr Lukashenka. Since October 2020, the EU has progressively imposed restrictive measures against Belarus. The measures were adopted in response to the fraudulent nature of the presidential elections in Belarus, and the intimidation and violent repression of peaceful protesters, opposition members and journalists. This decision of the fourth package of EU sanctions was made in view of the escalation of serious human rights violations in Belarus and the violent repression of civil society, democratic opposition and journalists. Moreover, seven individuals and one entity subject to this new round of restrictive measures were designated in connection to the forced and unlawful landing of flight FR4978. The goal of these sanctions is to put pressure on the Belarusian political leadership to initiate a genuine and inclusive national dialogue with broader society and to avoid further repression. The EU is ready to bring new sanctions against Belarus if the situation in the country - which the bloc accuses of pushing asylum seekers across its borders - continues to deteriorate. The claim that the EU does not respect the rights and freedom of Belorusian people is speculation. The EU and the West demand the Belarusian authorities to respect their own people's fundamental rights. The West does not seek to destroy and impoverish Belarus. The European Commission has offered a comprehensive plan of economic support to a future democratic Belarus. The plan, of up to €3 billion, reflects the European Union's commitment to supporting the Belarusian people's wishes for a peaceful democratic transition in the country. Read similar cases: The EU wants to bring down the Belarusian economy and create conditions for a new coup; The EU wants to take the Belarusians by hunger through the economic war; The EU sanctions were imposed to impoverish common people.

Title: The civil war in Ukraine started because of NATO
Disinformation: The civil war in Ukraine started precisely because of NATO. [...] The Anglo-Saxons have staged a coup d'état in Ukraine, put their puppets in power and turned Ukraine itself into an "anti-Russia" project that poses a real threat on its borders. [...] When I hear from our puppet government that Ukraine is NATO's eastern front, I realise that these puppets are not serving Ukraine, but NATO's interests.
Information: Two interconnected recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narratives are used in this piece. One about the war in Ukraine, claiming that Russia is not part of the conflict in Donbas, and that NATO is responsible for it, i.e. that Russia has nothing to do with the war in eastern Ukraine and presenting the conflict as a “civil war”, started by NATO. The other is about an alleged anti-constitutional coup in Ukraine in 2014; this is a longstanding pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about Ukraine's Euromaidan protests.The spontaneous onset of the Euromaidan protests was a reaction from several segments of the Ukrainian population to former President Yanukovych’s sudden departure from the promised Association Agreement with the European Union in November 2013, after pressure from Russia. See the full debunk: The Western-backed coup in Ukraine has torn the country asunder. As for Russia's ‘role within the war in Ukraine, the European Union stated in July 2014 that "arms and fighters continue flowing into Ukraine from the Russian Federation". At the NATO Summit in Wales in September 2014, NATO leaders condemned in the strongest terms Russia’s military intervention in Ukraine and demanded Russia to stop and withdraw its forces from Ukraine and from the country’s border. NATO leaders also demanded Russia comply with international law and its international obligations and responsibilities; refrain from aggressive actions against Ukraine; halt the flow of weapons, equipment, people and money across the border to the separatists; and stop fomenting tension along and across the Ukrainian border. In 2015, Russian President Vladimir Putin admitted Russia's military presence in Ukraine. See similar disinformation cases alleging that in 2014 coup Kyiv government carried out a war against its own people, Donbas rebelled because Russians in Ukraine were subjected to ethnocide, that after Euromaidan Ukraine lost its sovereignty and is falling apart, that the Euromaidan coup led to civil war in Donbas, or that Ukraine committed a crime by attacking its citizens in Donbas in 2014.

Title: It is absurd to claim that Russia is hindering the settlement of the conflict in Donbas
Disinformation: It is absurd to say that Russia is hindering the settlement of the conflict [in Donbas]. Russia is behaving in a hyper-tactical and hyper-diplomatic manner.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about the war in Ukraine. Contrary to the claim, the main impediment to a peace settlement in Donbas is, in fact, Russia’s and its proxies’ deliberate unwillingness to implement the Minsk agreements. These documents, signed by representatives of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), Ukraine, Russia and leaders of the illegal separatist entities (DNR and LNR), provide, among other things, for a comprehensive ceasefire and withdrawal of foreign troops from Ukraine. Kyiv announced a truce in July 2020, but the Moscow-backed separatists have been violating it virtually every day. See here about EU restrictive measures in response to the crisis in Ukraine.

Title: NATO was not created for peace, it was created for confrontation
Outlets: ru.armeniasputnik.am, RBC.ru, RIA, vesti.ru, tass.ru, Kommersant, vz.ru
Disinformation: NATO's strategy to contain the Russian Federation most vividly confirms the correctness of Moscow's decision to end the official dialogue with the alliance. Moscow has never harboured illusions about the essence of NATO, and this essence is being reaffirmed. The Alliance was not created for peace, it was created for confrontation, it was conceived and designed for this.
Information: Recurring pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative about NATO. NATO is a defensive alliance with primary aims to maintain peace and safeguard the independence, security and territorial integrity of its members. NATO constitutes a system of collective defence whereby its member states agree to mutual defence in response to an attack by any external party.Relations between NATO and the Russian Federation were established in 1991 within the framework of the North Atlantic Cooperation Council. In 1994, Russia joined the Partnership for Peace program, and since that time, NATO and Russia have signed several important agreements on cooperation. For more than two decades, NATO has worked to build a partnership with Russia and not to contain it. In October 2021, NATO withdrew the accreditation of eight members of the Russian Mission to NATO, who were undeclared Russian intelligence officers.
